item.title: TPL 7: GS Delhi Aces Register Biggest Win Of Season; Join SG Pipers, Mumbai Eagles, Rajasthan Rangers In Semis (Ld)
item.description: Gujarat University Tennis Stadium: GS Delhi Aces registered the biggest margin of victory this season, booking their semifinal berth alongside SG Pipers, Yash Mumbai Eagles, and Rajasthan Rangers on the penultimate day of the Tennis Premier League (TPL) Season 7, which witnessed high-octane tennis action at the Gujarat University Tennis Stadium in Ahmedabad on Saturday.

item.title: IND vs SA 3rd T20I: Approaching Milestones and Records Ahead of Dharamsala Clash
item.description: Team India will square off with South Africa in the third game of the five-match T20I series at Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association on Sunday.

item.title: Squash World Cup: India Knock Out Egypt To Reach Maiden Final
item.description: Squash World Cup: National champions Velavan Senthilkumar and Anahat Singh won their respective men's and women's singles, as India stunned two-time defending champions Egypt 3-0 and stormed into the final of the Squash World Cup 2025 at the Express Avenue Mall in Chennai on Saturday.

item.title: ILT20: Jahangir’s 99 Steers Dubai Capitals To A Thrilling Nine-Run Victory Over Abu Dhabi Knight Riders
item.description: The Dubai Capitals fended off the Abu Dhabi Knight Riders to secure a nine-run victory at the Zayed Cricket Stadium on Saturday. The Capitals produced a composed performance to register a deserved win

item.title: De Arrascaeta Masterclass Sends Flamengo To FIFA Intercontinental Cup Final
item.description: FIFA Intercontinental Cup: Giorgian de Arrascaeta has provided a pair of assists for Leo Pereira and Danilo as Flamengo down Pyramids to book a date with Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) in the FIFA Intercontinental Cup final.

item.title: ‘What I Meant Was Five Intense Training Sessions: McCullum On His ‘over-prepared’ Remark On Gabba Loss
item.description: Brendon McCullum: England head coach Brendon McCullum clarified his “over-prepared” remark following the team’s defeat in the Gabba Test, saying he was referring to the five intense training sessions the side undertook.

item.title: Arsenal Edge Wolves To Go Five Points Clear In Premier League Standings
item.description: Premier League: An own goal deep into second-half stoppage time saw Arsenal edge past Wolverhampton Wanderers that keeps gunners top of the Premier League table.

item.title: Green Calls IPL Auction Listing Manager’s ‘stuff-up’, Says He’s ‘good To Bowl’
item.description: Cameron Green: Australia all-rounder Cameron Green has played down speculation over his classification for the IPL 2026 auction, clarifying that his listing as a batter rather than an all-rounder was due to an error by his manager, not a strategic move.

item.title: Messi Kolkata Event Chaos: More Cops Deployed Near Event Organiser's House
item.description: Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee: Following the chaos at the Yuba Bharati Krirangan stadium aka Salt Lake stadium in Kolkata during Lionel Messi's event, the police on Sunday increased security outside the event organiser, Satadru Dutta's house in Hooghly district's Rishra.

item.title: Kolkata's Image Takes Hit In International Media After Chaos At Messi's Event
item.description: The New York Times: After the chaos at Yuva Bharati Krirangan, also known as Salt Lake Stadium, in Kolkata during Lionel Messi's event, the image of Kolkata has taken a beating on the international stage as the vandalism made headlines in major newspapers and media houses across the world.
